sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Hobbies bring joy to our life.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɒbiz bɹˈɪŋ ʤˈɔɪ tʊ ˌaʊə lˈaɪf./
sentences.meaning: 爱好给我们的生活带来快乐。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: think about why hobbies are important for us.
sentences.ipa: /θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt wˌaɪ hˈɒbiz ɑː ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt fɔː ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: 想想为什么爱好对我们很重要

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: The Class 1, Grade 7 students are talking about their hobbies.
sentences.ipa: /ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðɛː hˈɒbiz./
sentences.meaning: 一年级7年级的学生在谈论他们的爱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Let’s share our favourite hobbies with classmates.
sentences.ipa: /lˈɛts ʃˈɛː ˌaʊə fˈeɪvəɹɪt hˈɒbiz wɪð klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 让我们和同学分享我们最喜欢的爱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: What do you like to do?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk tə dˈuː?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A What do the Class 1, Grade 7 students like to do?
sentences.ipa: /ɐ wˌɒt dˈuː ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts lˈaɪk tə dˈuː?/
sentences.meaning: 一年级7年级的学生喜欢做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their answers with the words in the box.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðɛː ˈɑːnsəz wɪð ðə wˈɜːdz ɪn ðə bˈɒks./
sentences.meaning: 用盒子里的话来填答

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Amy and Millie are talking about their hobbies.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː ˈeɪmi and mˈɪli ɑː tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ðɛː hˈɒbiz./
sentences.meaning: B艾米和米莉在谈论他们的爱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Work in pairs and talk about your hobbies.
sentences.ipa: /wˈɜːk ɪn pˈɛːz and tˈɔːk əbˈaʊt jɔː hˈɒbiz./
sentences.meaning: 双双工作 谈谈你的爱好

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use the conversation below as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːz ðə kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn bɪlˈəʊ az ɐ mˈɒdᵊl./
sentences.meaning: 以下面的对话为示范。

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: What’s your favourite hobby, Millie?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒts jɔː fˈeɪvəɹɪt hˈɒbi, mˈɪli?/
sentences.meaning: 米莉，你最喜欢的爱好是什么？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I love reading.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv ɹˈiːdɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢阅读。

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: What do you like to read?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈuː juː lˈaɪk tə ɹˈiːd?/
sentences.meaning: 你喜欢看什么？

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: I read all kinds of books, and I learn a lot from them. What about you?
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɹˈɛd ˈɔːl kˈaɪndz ɒv bˈʊks, and ˌaɪ lˈɜːn ɐ lˈɒt fɹɒm ðˌɛm. wˌɒt əbˈaʊt juː?/
sentences.meaning: ▁我读过各种书，从中学到了很多东西，你呢？

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: I like swimming.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈaɪk swˈɪmɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢游泳

sentences.speaker: millie
sentences.text: How often do you go swimming?
sentences.ipa: /hˌaʊ ˈɒfᵊn dˈuː juː ɡˌəʊ swˈɪmɪŋ?/
sentences.meaning: 你什么时候去游泳？

sentences.speaker: amy
sentences.text: I go swimming every week. It helps me keep fit.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɡˌəʊ swˈɪmɪŋ ˈɛvəɹi wˈiːk. ˌɪt hˈɛlps mˌiː kˈiːp fˈɪt./
sentences.meaning: 我每周都会游泳 它帮助我保持健康。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C What hobbies do your family members or your friends have?
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː wˌɒt hˈɒbiz dˈuː jɔː fˈamɪli mˈɛmbəz ɔː jɔː fɹˈɛndz hˈav?/
sentences.meaning: C 你的家人或朋友有什么爱好？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Give an example.
sentences.ipa: /ɡˈɪv ɐn ɪɡzˈɑːmpᵊl./
sentences.meaning: 举个例子

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Mr Wu asked the Class 1, Grade 7 students to write an article about a friend’s hobby.
sentences.ipa: /mˈɪstə wˈuː ˈɑːskt ðə klˈɑːs wˈʌn, ɡɹˈeɪd sˈɛvᵊn stjˈuːdnts tə ɹˈaɪt ɐn ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əbˈaʊt ɐ fɹˈɛndz hˈɒbi./
sentences.meaning: 吴先生要求一年级七年级的学生写一篇关于朋友爱好的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Here is Millie’s article about Daniel.
sentences.ipa: /hˈɪə ɪz mˈɪliz ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əbˈaʊt dˈanjəl./
sentences.meaning: 这是米莉关于丹尼尔的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Before reading, think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bɪfˈɔː ɹˈiːdɪŋ, θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 在阅读前，考虑下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Do you like science?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn dˈuː juː lˈaɪk sˈaɪəns?/
sentences.meaning: 1 你喜欢科学吗？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why or why not?
sentences.ipa: /wˌaɪ ɔː wˌaɪ nˌɒt?/
sentences.meaning: 为什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What do you think a fan of science often does?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈuː juː θˈɪŋk ɐ fˈan ɒv sˈaɪəns ˈɒfᵊn dˈʌz?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你觉得一个爱好科学的人经常做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We use an exclamation mark (!)
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː jˈuːz ɐn ˌɛkskləmˈeɪʃᵊn mˈɑːk (!)/
sentences.meaning: 我们使用感叹标记(！)

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: to express love, surprise, joy or other strong feelings.
sentences.ipa: /tʊ ɪkspɹˈɛs lˈʌv, səpɹˈaɪz, ʤˈɔɪ ɔː ˈʌðə stɹˈɒŋ fˈiːlɪŋz./
sentences.meaning: 表达爱、惊喜、欢乐或其他强烈的感情。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Daniel is one of my new friends.
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl ɪz wˈʌn ɒv maɪ njˈuː fɹˈɛndz./
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔是我新朋友之一

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He is a fan of science.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː ɪz ɐ fˈan ɒv sˈaɪəns./
sentences.meaning: 他是科学的粉丝。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He thinks science is very cool.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː θˈɪŋks sˈaɪəns ɪz vˈɛɹi kˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 他认为科学非常酷。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is all around us.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ˈɔːl əɹˈaʊnd ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: 它在我们周围。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Science changes our lives!
sentences.ipa: /sˈaɪəns ʧˈeɪnʤɪz ˌaʊə lˈaɪvz!/
sentences.meaning: 科学改变了我们的生活！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Daniel often visits science museums.
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl ˈɒfᵊn vˈɪzɪts sˈaɪəns mjuːzˈiːəmz./
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔经常访问科学博物馆。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He gets to see all kinds of things and learns a lot.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː ɡɛts tə sˈiː ˈɔːl kˈaɪndz ɒv θˈɪŋz and lˈɜːnz ɐ lˈɒt./
sentences.meaning: 得见一切众生悉得成就。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is great fun for him.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ɡɹˈeɪt fˈʌn fɔː hˌɪm./
sentences.meaning: 对他来说这很有趣

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: At home, he likes to take things apart and learn how they work.
sentences.ipa: /ˌat hˈəʊm, hiː lˈaɪks tə tˈeɪk θˈɪŋz əpˈɑːt and lˈɜːn hˌaʊ ðeɪ wˈɜːk./
sentences.meaning: 在家里，他喜欢把东西拆散，学会如何工作。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Now he can help fix things around the house!
sentences.ipa: /nˈaʊ hiː kan hˈɛlp fˈɪks θˈɪŋz əɹˈaʊnd ðə hˈaʊs!/
sentences.meaning: 现在他可以帮助修复 周围的东西！

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: In his free time, Daniel reads many science books.
sentences.ipa: /ɪn hɪz fɹˈiː tˈaɪm, dˈanjəl ɹˈiːdz mˈɛni sˈaɪəns bˈʊks./
sentences.meaning: 在他的自由时期，丹尼尔阅读了许多科学书籍。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He also goes on the internet to find answers to his endless questions.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː ˈɔːlsəʊ ɡˈəʊz ˌɒn ði ˈɪntənɛt tə fˈaɪnd ˈɑːnsəz tə hɪz ˈɛndləs kwˈɛsʧᵊnz./
sentences.meaning: 他还在网上寻找他无尽问题的答案。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He wants to be a scientist one day.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː wˈɒnts tə biː ɐ sˈaɪəntɪst wˈʌn dˈeɪ./
sentences.meaning: 他想成为科学家

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am sure his dream can come true.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɐm ʃˈʊə hɪz dɹˈiːm kan kˈʌm tɹˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 我相信他的梦想能够实现。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: A Complete the chart below with the information in the article.
sentences.ipa: /ɐ kəmplˈiːt ðə ʧˈɑːt bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ði ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃᵊn ɪn ði ˈɑːtɪkᵊl./
sentences.meaning: a 下图附文章中的资料。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B Read the article again and answer the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː ɹˈiːd ði ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əɡˈɛn and ˈɑːnsə ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: B 重读文章并回答下面的问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 Why does Daniel think science is cool?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn wˌaɪ dˈʌz dˈanjəl θˈɪŋk sˈaɪəns ɪz kˈuːl?/
sentences.meaning: 1为什么丹尼尔认为科学很酷？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What does Daniel do at science museums?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt dˈʌz dˈanjəl dˈuː at sˈaɪəns mjuːzˈiːəmz?/
sentences.meaning: 2 丹尼尔在科学博物馆做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 What does Daniel like to do at home?
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː wˌɒt dˈʌz dˈanjəl lˈaɪk tə dˈuː at hˈəʊm?/
sentences.meaning: 3，丹尼尔喜欢在家里做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 What does Daniel look for on the internet?
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː wˌɒt dˈʌz dˈanjəl lˈʊk fɔː ˌɒn ði ˈɪntənɛt?/
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔在网络上找什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 How does the article show Daniel’s love for science?
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv hˌaʊ dˈʌz ði ˈɑːtɪkᵊl ʃˈəʊ dˈanjəlz lˈʌv fɔː sˈaɪəns?/
sentences.meaning: 5 文章如何显示丹尼尔对科学的热爱？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: C Kitty is asking Millie questions about Daniel.
sentences.ipa: /sˈiː kˈɪti ɪz ˈaskɪŋ mˈɪli kwˈɛsʧᵊnz əbˈaʊt dˈanjəl./
sentences.meaning: 凯蒂在问米莉关于丹尼尔的问题

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct forms of the words and phrases in the box below.
sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðɛː kˌɒnvəsˈeɪʃᵊn wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə wˈɜːdz and fɹˈeɪzɪz ɪn ðə bˈɒks bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 完成与以下框中文字和短语的正确形式的对话。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: come true change endless go on the internet fix museum scientist take …
sentences.ipa: /kˈʌm tɹˈuː ʧˈeɪnʤ ˈɛndləs ɡˌəʊ ˌɒn ði ˈɪntənɛt fˈɪks mjuːzˈiːəm sˈaɪəntɪst tˈeɪk …/
sentences.meaning: 真正的改变无止境 上互联网 固定博物馆的科学家采取..。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Daniel is a big fan of science. He can often answer our questions about science. Why does he like it so much?
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl ɪz ɐ bˈɪɡ fˈan ɒv sˈaɪəns. hˌiː kan ˈɒfᵊn ˈɑːnsə ˌaʊə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz əbˈaʊt sˈaɪəns. wˌaɪ dˈʌz hiː lˈaɪk ɪt sˌəʊ mˈʌʧ?/
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔是科学的忠实粉丝，他经常能回答我们有关科学的问题，为什么他那么喜欢？

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: So, what does he do in his free time?
sentences.ipa: /sˌəʊ, wˌɒt dˈʌz hiː dˈuː ɪn hɪz fɹˈiː tˈaɪm?/
sentences.meaning: 那么，他在空闲时间做什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: In this way, he learns how they work.
sentences.ipa: /ɪn ðɪs wˈeɪ, hiː lˈɜːnz hˌaʊ ðeɪ wˈɜːk./
sentences.meaning: 通过这种方式，他学会了他们是如何工作的。

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: Wow, so cool!
sentences.ipa: /wˈaʊ, sˌəʊ kˈuːl!/
sentences.meaning: 哇，这么酷！

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: What does he use the internet to do?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈʌz hiː jˈuːz ði ˈɪntənɛt tə dˈuː?/
sentences.meaning: 他用互联网做什么？

sentences.speaker: kitty
sentences.text: What does he want to be?
sentences.ipa: /wˌɒt dˈʌz hiː wˈɒnt tə bˈiː?/
sentences.meaning: 他想成为什么样的人？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Think about the questions below.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θˈɪŋk əbˈaʊt ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: D 考虑以下问题。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Share your answers with your classmates.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈɛː jɔː ˈɑːnsəz wɪð jɔː klˈɑːsmeɪts./
sentences.meaning: 与同学分享答案。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 How do you find answers to questions about science?
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn hˌaʊ dˈuː juː fˈaɪnd ˈɑːnsəz tə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz əbˈaʊt sˈaɪəns?/
sentences.meaning: 1 你如何找到科学问题的答案？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 What other ways do you know to learn about science?
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː wˌɒt ˈʌðə wˈeɪz dˈuː juː nˈəʊ tə lˈɜːn əbˈaʊt sˈaɪəns?/
sentences.meaning: 2，你知道哪些其他方法来学习科学？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 Why is it important for us to have hobbies?
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː wˌaɪ ɪz ɪt ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt fɔː ˌʌs tə hav hˈɒbiz?/
sentences.meaning: 3 为什么我们一定要有爱好？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read the sentences below and pay attention to the use of the verbs.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ðə sˈɛntᵊnsɪz bɪlˈəʊ and pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃᵊn tə ðə jˈuːs ɒv ðə vˈɜːbz./
sentences.meaning: 阅读下面的句子，注意动词的使用。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Science changes people’s lives.
sentences.ipa: /sˈaɪəns ʧˈeɪnʤɪz pˈiːpᵊlz lˈaɪvz./
sentences.meaning: 科学改变了人们的生活。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Daniel likes to take things apart.
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl lˈaɪks tə tˈeɪk θˈɪŋz əpˈɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔喜欢把事情分开

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Daniel often visits science museums.
sentences.ipa: /dˈanjəl ˈɒfᵊn vˈɪzɪts sˈaɪəns mjuːzˈiːəmz./
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔经常访问科学博物馆。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I/You/We/They like sport.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ jˌuː wˌiː ðˌeɪ lˈaɪk spˈɔːt./
sentences.meaning: 我/你/我们/他们喜欢运动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I/You/We/They do not like sport.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ jˌuː wˌiː ðˌeɪ dˈuː nˌɒt lˈaɪk spˈɔːt./
sentences.meaning: 我/你/我们/他们不喜欢运动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Do I/you/we/they like sport?
sentences.ipa: /dˈuː ˌaɪ juː wiː ðeɪ lˈaɪk spˈɔːt?/
sentences.meaning: 我/你/我们/他们喜欢运动？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Does he/she/it Yes, I/you/we/they do.
sentences.ipa: /dˈʌz hiː ʃiː ɪt jˈɛs, ˌaɪ juː wiː ðeɪ dˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 是的，我/你/我们/他们。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: he/she/it does.
sentences.ipa: /hiː ʃiː ɪt dˈʌz./
sentences.meaning: 就是这样

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: No, I/you/we/they do not.
sentences.ipa: /nˈəʊ, ˌaɪ juː wiː ðeɪ dˈuː nˌɒt./
sentences.meaning: 不，我/你/我们/他们没有。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: he/she/it does not.
sentences.ipa: /hiː ʃiː ɪt dˈʌz nˌɒt./
sentences.meaning: 他/她/它没有。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: When we make negative sentences and ask questions, • we use (do, does) with I, you, we and they; • we use (do, does) with he, she and it.
sentences.ipa: /wˌɛn wiː mˌeɪk nˈɛɡətɪv sˈɛntᵊnsɪz and ˈɑːsk kwˈɛsʧᵊnz, wiː jˈuːz (dˈuː, dˈʌz) wɪð ˌaɪ, juː, wiː and ðeɪ; wiː jˈuːz (dˈuː, dˈʌz) wɪð hiː, ʃiː and ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 当我们作负面的句子和提问时，我们使用(做，做)我，你，我们和他们;我们使用(做，做)他，她和它。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Remember that we add -s to the verb after he, she or it.
sentences.ipa: /ɹɪmˈɛmbə ðat wiː ˈad ˈɛs tə ðə vˈɜːb ˈɑːftə hiː, ʃiː ɔː ɪt./
sentences.meaning: 记住，我们在动词后面加 - 之后，她或它。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: However, there are some exceptions.
sentences.ipa: /haʊˈɛvə, ðɛː ɑː sˌʌm ɪksˈɛpʃᵊnz./
sentences.meaning: 然而，有一些例外。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Turn to page 141 for changes in pronun- ciation.
sentences.ipa: /tˈɜːn tə pˈeɪʤ wˈʌn hˈʌndɹəd fˈɔːti wˈʌn fɔː ʧˈeɪnʤɪz ˈɪn./
sentences.meaning: 翻至第141页，以进行亲子化变化。

sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə sˈɛntᵊnsɪz bɪlˈəʊ wɪð ðə kəɹˈɛkt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə vˈɜːbz ɪn ðə bˈɒks./

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: B The students are writing their names under the activities they like in the table below.
sentences.ipa: /bˈiː ðə stjˈuːdnts ɑː ɹˈaɪtɪŋ ðɛː nˈeɪmz ˈʌndə ði aktˈɪvɪtiz ðeɪ lˈaɪk ɪn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl bɪlˈəʊ./

sentences.ipa: /kəmplˈiːt ðə kwˈɛsʧᵊnz and ðˈɛn jˈuːz ði ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃᵊn ɪn ðə tˈeɪbᵊl tʊ ˈɑːnsə ðˌɛm./
sentences.meaning: 完成问题，然后使用表格中的信息来回答。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Yes, they do.
sentences.ipa: /jˈɛs, ðeɪ dˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 是的，他们这样做。

sentences.text: C Amy and Sandy are talking about their hobbies.

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Complete their conversation with the correct forms of the verbs in brackets.

sentences.speaker: amy

sentences.ipa: /hˈaɪ, sˈandi. wˌɒts jɔː hˈɒbi?/
sentences.meaning: 嗨，桑迪，你好吗？ 您的爱好是什么？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D Talk with your partner about your and your friends’ hobbies, using the correct forms of the verbs.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tˈɔːk wɪð jɔː pˈɑːtnə əbˈaʊt jɔː and jɔː fɹˈɛndz hˈɒbiz, jˈuːzɪŋ ðə kəɹˈɛkt fˈɔːmz ɒv ðə vˈɜːbz./

sentences.ipa: /ðˌeɪ ɑː dˈɪfəɹənt fɹɒm ðə sˈaʊndz ɪn jˈuːnɪt wˈʌn and ˈiːʧ sˈaʊnd ɪz ʃˈɔːt./
sentences.meaning: 它们与第1单元中的声音不同，每个声音都很短。

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.meaning: A 读以下文字。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Then put each one under the correct sound.

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /sˈiː ɹˈiːd ðə fˈɒləʊɪŋ pˈəʊɪm./
sentences.meaning: C 读以下诗。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Pay attention to the sounds of the letters in bold.
sentences.ipa: /pˈeɪ ətˈɛnʃᵊn tə ðə sˈaʊndz ɒv ðə lˈɛtəz ɪn bˈəʊld./
sentences.meaning: 注意用粗体表示字母的声音。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Or going swimming like a fish?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɔː ɡˈəʊɪŋ swˈɪmɪŋ lˈaɪk ɐ fˈɪʃ?/
sentences.meaning: 还是像鱼一样去游泳？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Or going for a long run?
sentences.ipa: /ˌɔː ɡˈəʊɪŋ fɔː ɐ lˈɒŋ ɹˈʌn?/
sentences.meaning: 还是去长期？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Well, all of these hobbies are so much fun!

sentences.meaning: 在阅读一个表格时，我们可以先看标题，以获得一个一般的想法。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 What sports clubs are there at Sunshine Middle School?

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: in a conversation to show interest, support or agreement.

sentences.meaning: ▁我喜欢科学，所以我对机器人俱乐部感兴趣。它会很有趣的。

sentences.speaker: sandy
sentences.text: Sure. Both of us will have a great time in our clubs.
sentences.ipa: /ʃˈʊə. bˈəʊθ ɒv ˌʌs wɪl hav ɐ ɡɹˈeɪt tˈaɪm ɪn ˌaʊə klˈʌbz./

sentences.ipa: /hˌaʊ ˈɒfᵊn dˈuː juː dˈuː ɪt?/

sentences.speaker: narrator

sentences.ipa: /wˌɛn dˈuː juː dˈuː ɪt?/

sentences.ipa: /ˈɑːftə skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 学后。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Why do you like it?
sentences.ipa: /wˌaɪ dˈuː juː lˈaɪk ɪt?/
sentences.meaning: 你为什么喜欢？

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is great fun.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ɡɹˈeɪt fˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: 这是伟大的乐趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Who is your role model?

sentences.meaning: 你的榜样是谁？

sentences.meaning: 许碧红。

sentences.meaning: 我的绘画技巧可以帮助我很多。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D2 Here is Sandy’s article about her favourite hobby.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː tˈuː hˈɪə ɪz sˈandiz ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əbˈaʊt hɜː fˈeɪvəɹɪt hˈɒbi./
sentences.meaning: D2是Sandy的文章，

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Read it below.
sentences.ipa: /ɹˈiːd ɪt bɪlˈəʊ./
sentences.meaning: 下读。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We capitalize the first letter of each sentence.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː kˈapɪtəlaɪz ðə fˈɜːst lˈɛtə ɒv ˈiːʧ sˈɛntᵊns./
sentences.meaning: 我们利用每一句的第一个字母。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I love painting.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ lˈʌv pˈeɪntɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 我喜欢画画。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It makes me feel happy.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt mˌeɪks mˌiː fˈiːl hˈapi./
sentences.meaning: 这让我感到快乐。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I paint every week.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ pˈeɪnt ˈɛvəɹi wˈiːk./
sentences.meaning: 我每周画画

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I often paint with my friends after school.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ˈɒfᵊn pˈeɪnt wɪð maɪ fɹˈɛndz ˈɑːftə skˈuːl./
sentences.meaning: 我放学后经常和朋友一起画画。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: We enjoy sharing our paintings and talking about art.
sentences.ipa: /wˌiː ɪnʤˈɔɪ ʃˈɛːɹɪŋ ˌaʊə pˈeɪntɪŋz and tˈɔːkɪŋ əbˈaʊt ˈɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 我们喜欢分享我们的画和谈论艺术。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is great fun.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz ɡɹˈeɪt fˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: 这是伟大的乐趣。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My favourite artist is Xu Beihong.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ fˈeɪvəɹɪt ˈɑːtɪst ɪz sˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 我最喜欢的艺术家是徐碧红

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: He was a master of Chinese painting.
sentences.ipa: /hˌiː wɒz ɐ mˈɑːstə ɒv ʧˌaɪnˈiːz pˈeɪntɪŋ./
sentences.meaning: 曾任中国画大师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: His paintings of horses are great works of art.
sentences.ipa: /hˌɪz pˈeɪntɪŋz ɒv hˈɔːsɪz ɑː ɡɹˈeɪt wˈɜːks ɒv ˈɑːt./
sentences.meaning: 他的马画是伟大的艺术品。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I want to become a designer.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ wˈɒnt tə bɪkˈʌm ɐ dɪzˈaɪnə./
sentences.meaning: 我想成为一个设计师。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I would like to design beautiful clothes in the future.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ wʊd lˈaɪk tə dɪzˈaɪn bjˈuːtɪfʊl klˈəʊðz ɪn ðə fjˈuːʧə./
sentences.meaning: 我想在未来设计漂亮的衣服。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: My painting skills can help me a lot.
sentences.ipa: /mˌaɪ pˈeɪntɪŋ skˈɪlz kan hˈɛlp mˌiː ɐ lˈɒt./
sentences.meaning: 我的绘画技巧可以帮助我很多。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I hope my dream can come true.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ hˈəʊp maɪ dɹˈiːm kan kˈʌm tɹˈuː./
sentences.meaning: 我希望我的梦想能够实现。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: D3 Write an article about your favourite hobby based on the information in Part D1.
sentences.ipa: /dˈiː θɹˈiː ɹˈaɪt ɐn ˈɑːtɪkᵊl əbˈaʊt jɔː fˈeɪvəɹɪt hˈɒbi bˈeɪst ˌɒn ði ˌɪnfəmˈeɪʃᵊn ɪn pˈɑːt dˈiː wˈʌn./
sentences.meaning: D3 根据D1部分中的信息写一篇关于你最喜欢的爱好的文章。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Use Sandy’s article as a model.
sentences.ipa: /jˈuːs sˈandiz ˈɑːtɪkᵊl az ɐ mˈɒdᵊl./
sentences.meaning: 以桑迪的文章为榜样。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 1 I can describe Daniel’s and his classmates’ hobbies.
sentences.ipa: /wˈʌn ˌaɪ kan dɪskɹˈaɪb dˈanjəl”ˈɛs and hɪz klˈɑːsmeɪts hˈɒbiz./
sentences.meaning: 丹尼尔和同学的爱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 2 I can use the simple present tense correctly.
sentences.ipa: /tˈuː ˌaɪ kan jˈuːz ðə sˈɪmpᵊl pɹˈɛzᵊnt tˈɛns kəɹˈɛktli./
sentences.meaning: 2，我可以使用简单的 当前时态正确。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 3 I can talk and write about different hobbies with the new words in this unit.
sentences.ipa: /θɹˈiː ˌaɪ kan tˈɔːk and ɹˈaɪt əbˈaʊt dˈɪfəɹənt hˈɒbiz wɪð ðə njˈuː wˈɜːdz ɪn ðɪs jˈuːnɪt./
sentences.meaning: 3，我可以用这个单位的新词来谈论和写不同的爱好。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 4 I can pronounce the sounds /C/, /e/, /I/, /B/ and /V/ correctly in words.
sentences.ipa: /fˈɔː ˌaɪ kan pɹənˈaʊns ðə sˈaʊndz sˈiː, ˈiː, ˈaɪ, bˈiː and vˈiː kəɹˈɛktli ɪn wˈɜːdz./
sentences.meaning: 4，我可以用文字正确发音/C/，/e/，/I/，/B/和/V/。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: 5 I know why hobbies are important for us.
sentences.ipa: /fˈaɪv ˌaɪ nˈəʊ wˌaɪ hˈɒbiz ɑː ɪmpˈɔːtᵊnt fɔː ˌʌs./
sentences.meaning: 5，我知道为什么爱好对我们很重要。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: * Assess your learning of new words and grammar by doing the exercises on page 109.
sentences.ipa: /əsˈɛs jɔː lˈɜːnɪŋ ɒv njˈuː wˈɜːdz and ɡɹˈamə baɪ dˈuːɪŋ ði ˈɛksəsaɪzɪz ˌɒn pˈeɪʤ wˈʌn hˈʌndɹəd nˈaɪn./
sentences.meaning: * 通过第109页的练习评估你对新词和语法的学习。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I am good at.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ ɐm ɡˈʊd at./
sentences.meaning: 我擅长。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: I need to spend more time on.
sentences.ipa: /ˌaɪ nˈiːd tə spˈɛnd mˈɔː tˈaɪm ˌɒn./
sentences.meaning: 我需要花更多的时间。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: Skateboarding is a fun and exciting sport.
sentences.ipa: /skˈeɪtbɔːdɪŋ ɪz ɐ fˈʌn and ɪksˈaɪtɪŋ spˈɔːt./
sentences.meaning: 滑板是一个有趣和激动人心的运动。

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: the sport made it to the Olympics for the first time.
sentences.ipa: /ðə spˈɔːt mˌeɪd ɪt tə ði əlˈɪmpɪks fɔː ðə fˈɜːst tˈaɪm./
sentences.meaning: 运动会第一次来到奥运会

sentences.speaker: narrator
sentences.text: It is quite popular with young people these days.
sentences.ipa: /ˌɪt ɪz kwˈaɪt pˈɒpjʊlə wɪð jˈʌŋ pˈiːpᵊl ðiːz dˈeɪz./
sentences.meaning: 最近，它受到年轻人的欢迎。
